description: This file defines the PageAgentDispatcher class, which handles communication and operations related to a 'page agent' within a browser automation or testing framework. It manages tasks such as perform, expect, extract, and usage, and dispatches events related to conversation turns in a loop-based environment.

classes.name: PageAgentDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class for managing page agent interactions, events, and state within a browser automation context.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Executes a perform task on the page agent with progress tracking.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Sets or verifies an expectation on the page agent with progress tracking.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts data from the page based on query and schema, returning results.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Retrieves current usage statistics related to the page agent.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Handles disposal or cleanup of the dispatcher.
